# Zipchat

> Zipchat is an AI customer engagement platform with two modes: an
> e-commerce AI agent that crawls a store's content and catalog to sell
> and support across website chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and
> email, and Zipchat Code, which connects to a live Git codebase (GitHub,
> GitLab, Bitbucket) to answer product and technical questions with
> sourced accuracy. Both modes run on the same Agentic AI Search engine,
> speak 95+ languages, and support human handoff. Paid plans start at
> $49/month with a 7-day trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Built
> for Shopify certified.

- Zipchat is two products in one platform. E-commerce mode reads a website and product catalog. Zipchat Code reads a live codebase, not stale documentation.
- The same Agentic AI Search engine powers both modes across every channel: website widget, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, email, and AI Search.

## Product

- [Zipchat](https://www.zipchat.ai/index.html.md): AI agent for ecommerce and SaaS, built on Agentic AI Search
- [AI platform](https://www.zipchat.ai/ai-platform.md): The Agentic AI Search engine powering every mode and channel
- [How it works: ecommerce](https://www.zipchat.ai/how-it-works/ecommerce.md): How Zipchat connects to a store and runs AI sales and support across channels
- [How it works: SaaS](https://www.zipchat.ai/how-it-works/saas.md): How Zipchat Code reads a live codebase to answer product and technical questions
- [Pricing](https://www.zipchat.ai/pricing.md): Plans from $49/month, 7-day trial, 30-day money-back guarantee

## Use cases

- [Automate support](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/automate-support): Leverage advanced generative AI to provide instant, 24/7, multilingual customer support while reducing operational costs.
- [Customer insights](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/customer-insights): Turn every chat into actionable intelligence. Zipchat surfaces purchase objections, demand gaps, satisfaction trends, and competitor mentions automatically.
- [Increase average order value](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/increase-average-order-value): Boost AOV by 21% with conversation-aware upsells, free shipping threshold nudges, and bundle recommendations that feel like advice, not advertising.
- [Increase sales](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/increase-sales): Turn browsers into buyers with proactive AI engagement, real-time objection handling, and contextual upsells that convert hesitation into revenue.
- [Internal knowledge base](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/internal-knowledge-base): One AI search across Slack, Notion, GitHub, and Linear. Your team finds answers in seconds without interrupting senior engineers.
- [Reduce cart abandonment](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/reduce-cart-abandonment): Recover an average of 18% of abandoned carts with on-site AI engagement, WhatsApp recovery messages sent within minutes, and smart incentive gating.
- [Technical pre-sales](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/technical-pre-sales): Answer technical pre-sales questions instantly from your docs and codebase. Deals move faster when buyers get unblocked at evaluation.
- [Ticket deflection](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/ticket-deflection): Deflect 95%+ of SaaS support tickets automatically, including technical ones. Under 5% escalation rate to human agents.
- [WhatsApp marketing](https://www.zipchat.ai/use-cases/whatsapp-marketing): Market on the channel with 98% open rates. Zipchat gives you compliant broadcast campaigns, AI follow-up sequences, and two-way conversations on WhatsApp.

## Comparisons

- [Gorgias](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/gorgias.md): Gorgias started as a Chrome extension. Its billing model still protects that origin. See how Zipchat turns your Shopify tickets into revenue and saves $8,532/year.
- [Zendesk](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/zendesk.md): Compare Zipchat and Zendesk for ecommerce and SaaS. Pricing, AI architecture, setup time, and real performance data side by side. Start your free trial.
- [Intercom](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/intercom.md): Intercom charges $0.99 per AI resolution with no ceiling. Zipchat automates support, generates revenue, and gets cheaper as you scale. No annual contracts.
- [Tidio](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/tidio.md): Tidio caps at 10 agents and bills $749+ after that. Zipchat replaces Tidio with WhatsApp cart recovery, proactive AI, and no seat ceiling.
- [Freshdesk](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/freshdesk.md): Freshdesk costs $1,580/mo for real AI use. Zipchat starts at $499 with proactive sales, WhatsApp cart recovery, and zero cold-start. Compare and switch free.
- [Rep AI](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/rep-ai.md): Rep AI charges per visitor whether they engage or not. Zipchat charges per conversation, runs proactive WhatsApp cart recovery at 19.8%+ rates, and supports 95 languages. Same results, $700+ less per month.
- [Chatty](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/chatty.md): Chatty handles your inbox. Zipchat reaches customers first. Compare AI chat, WhatsApp cart recovery, and proactive sales for Shopify stores. Start your free trial.
- [LiveChat](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/livechat.md): Compare Zipchat and LiveChat for Shopify stores. Real pricing breakdown, AI architecture, cart recovery, and no billing surprises. Start free in 20 minutes.
- [Re:amaze](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/reamaze.md): Re:amaze manages tickets. Zipchat generates revenue. Compare AI quality, real pricing, and ecommerce features. No per-seat fees. Live in 20 minutes.
- [Richpanel](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/richpanel.md): Compare Zipchat and Richpanel for ecommerce. Real pricing, AI architecture, and setup time. Richpanel AI requires human review for every reply. Zipchat resolves autonomously. Start free.
- [Drift](https://www.zipchat.ai/alternatives/drift.md): Drift is sunsetting in 2026. Compare Zipchat Code vs Drift: codebase AI, pricing, setup time, and technical support accuracy. Free plan. Live in 20 minutes.
